asked_by: Madhav, 28 Oct 2026 12:23 Toronto: "i approve all" (the 12 reconstruction drafts waiting for his yes: 8 missed situations, 2 reference-trader gaps, 1 pullback exit lesson, 1 random-control family held into falls)
title: The 12 reconstruction drafts of 26-27 Oct: is there a rule, known at the previous close, for the situations no family was positioned for; would a time stop have fixed the pullback trades that never worked; and would a faster exit change the random control that held into falls?
hypothesis: Each missed situation has a version known before the move: a stock in that state at yesterday's close moves in the missed direction the next session more than the average liquid stock does (falls: breaking below its 20-day range, a 52-week low, a fall below the 200-day average, a pullback in an uptrend; rises: a rise below the 200-day average, a stock inside its range in an uptrend), and the reference traders' multi-day trips in the two gap situations beat the average stock over 5 sessions; for pullback-in-an-uptrend entries, leaving at the next open when a trade has not gained a quarter of its planned risk by the third close beats holding 20 sessions; the same time stop helps the random liquid picks, and more so while the Nifty is under its 200-day average.

drafts.note: The day shapes in the drafts (gap down held, intraday selloff, steady, intraday run) happen during the move itself and cannot be known before it; the only honest 'rule known before the move' is the stock's state at the previous close, so drafts 3 and 4 share one variant and the shape is reported as information (the share of next sessions with that shape, against all liquid stocks).

data.stock_panel: gold/teachers/stock_panel.parquet 2000-2023 (adjusted daily bars and indicators per stock; liq_rank from 60-day median turnover)
data.pull_entries: gold/studies/E02-PULL_trades.parquet: the registered pullback entry set (uptrend, 5% under the 20-day average), unique stock and signal date, 2000-2023
data.nothing_sealed: no 2024+ row, no sealed folder, no holdout row

definitions.universe: liquid stocks: liq_rank <= 250 on the signal day; the base for every 'level' comparison is all liquid stocks on the same next session

states at the signal close t (all known.breakdown20: close below the lowest low of the previous 20 sessions
states at the signal close t (all known.newlow252: close below the lowest low of the previous 250 sessions
states at the signal close t (all known.downtrend_fall: below the 200-day average, down 2% or more on the day, not breakdown20, not newlow252
states at the signal close t (all known.uptrend_pullback: above the 200-day average, down 2% or more on the day, not breakdown20
states at the signal close t (all known.downtrend_rise: below the 200-day average, up 2% or more on the day
states at the signal close t (all known.inside_range: above the 200-day average, not a 20-day breakout, position in the 20-day range between 0.2 and 0.8, up 2% or more on the day

outcomes.next_oc: next session open to close (the intraday move the drafts describe)
outcomes.next_cc: close t to the next close
outcomes.fwd5: close t to the close 5 sessions later (the panel's fwd5)

definitions.hygiene: a next-session return above 50% either way, or a missing next bar, is dropped (corporate-action artefacts)
definitions.unproven3_vs_hold20: each entry bought at the next open with the shared 2-ATR stop (india.exitlab rules); A = hold 20 sessions (hold_20d, the reference exit); B = the same, but leave at the open of the 4th session when the high of the first 3 sessions never reached entry + 0.25 x risk; outcome B - A in net return per trade after delivery costs
definitions.CTL: random control: 5 liquid stocks drawn per session with a fixed seed (20261028), the paper book's control idea
definitions.CTL_downtrend: the CTL entries on sessions when the Nifty closed below its 200-day average

statistics.level: signal mean outcome minus the mean of all liquid stocks in the same calendar quarter, t across quarters (india.teachers_stock.level); quarters with fewer than 3 signals dropped
statistics.paired: unproven3_vs_hold20: per calendar month the mean of B - A, t across months
statistics.information_only: the signals' own mean next-session move, and for the intraday variants the mean after a 0.10% intraday round-trip cost in the drafted direction (short for falls, long for rises); the share of next sessions with the drafted day shape against all liquid stocks

bar.note: families 'technical' (46: CP1, SR1, XO1) and 'exit' (93: E02/E03/E07 and kin) plus these 12; k frozen at 151

not_claimed: Research only. A pass is a proposal at most: it would go to a 20-session paper trial and Madhav's yes before any book uses it. The random control (CTL) keeps its own rules whatever variant 8 shows, because it is the yardstick every family is judged against. Falls can only be traded intraday or through futures in India; a falling-side pass says nothing about whether a short is practical for this account.
